recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future changes are needed to the detailed ICD modifier guidance, make them in the THO/UTG source rather than in FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-13210 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested that the Using ICD-[x] guidance document allowable syntaxes for ICD codes, including dagger/asterisk modifiers and ICD-10-GM exclamation-mark secondary diagnosis modifiers, instead of recommending that those characters be omitted from Coding.code.
initial_application: The request was applied in core on 2018-04-02 by SVN-derived commits baa02c5372, 4a70358229, and 5bd3a27120, which updated source/icd.html with multiple-coding guidance and examples such as J21.8+ B95.6* and S62.32 Z33!.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later moved the Using X external code-system pages out of FHIR core and into HL7 Terminology. Current FHIR core keeps the active ICD row in source/terminologies-systems.html and links to https://terminology.hl7.org/ICD.html, while the language-specific THO page at https://terminology.hl7.org/en/ICD.html contains the FHIR-13210 modifier syntax guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. The current FHIR core checkout should not restore or duplicate source/icd.html because ICD usage details are now maintained in THO, and the external THO page already preserves the requested dagger/asterisk and ! examples.

related_jiras.note: Moved Using X external code-system pages from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology and explains why ICD syntax details are no longer maintained in this checkout.
Linked from FHIR-35933 as the UTG-side work for adding Using external code systems with FHIR content to THO.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue requiring ICD-[x] allowable syntaxes to include dagger-asterisk, *, !, and related modifiers.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final Vocabulary WG request for the seed issue.

evidence_items.summary: The SVN-derived GF#13210 commits updated source/icd.html with multiple-coding syntax and examples preserving +, *, and ! modifiers.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-13210 was historically applied in core before the ICD page moved.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue moved Using X external code-system pages from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology and deleted source/icd.html.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative detailed ICD guidance is intentionally outside the FHIR core checkout now.

evidence_items.summary: Current core navigation includes terminologies-systems.html under terminology documentation.
evidence_items.learned: The ICD row in terminologies-systems.html is part of the active current documentation surface.

evidence_items.summary: The ICD external code-system row links to https://terminology.hl7.org/ICD.html and directs readers to the Using ICD-[x] with HL7 Standards page for details.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR core currently delegates ICD syntax details to THO instead of duplicating them locally.

evidence_items.summary: The current THO ICD page documents dual coding with optional + and * characters and ICD-10-GM ! examples such as S62.32 Z33! and S62.32 Z33! O09.1! Z34.
evidence_items.learned: The substantive FHIR-13210 guidance is present in the authoritative external terminology page.
